definitions.explanation: A criminal charge for an unsuccessful attempt to kill someone. Frequently encountered in news reports about criminal cases.

examples.japanese: {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder.

examples.japanese: {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}{罪|ざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}している→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧。
examples.english: The man indicted for attempted murder is denying the charges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{留|と}めた→取り留める：15466_toritomeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}わった→切り替わる：28245_kirikawaru⟧。
examples.english: Because the victim survived, the charge was changed from murder to attempted murder.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term commonly appearing in crime news. Composed of ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧ (murder) + ⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧ (attempt, failure to complete). The ～⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧ suffix can attach to other crimes: {強盗未遂|ごうとうみすい} (attempted robbery), {放火未遂|ほうかみすい} (attempted arson).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧ (suspicion of attempted murder)
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}{罪|ざい} (the crime of attempted murder)
- {殺人未遂|さつじんみすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (arrest for attempted murder)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧: murder, homicide
- ⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧: attempted (but not completed)
- ⟦{既遂|きすい}→既遂：23639_kisui⟧: completed/consummated (crime)
